description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Writes a batch of draft hooks (on-screen card + spoken line) from the confirmed offers, claims-checked; blocked ones come back in `dropped`, unsaved. Charges Embers once per call (refunded when nothing usable comes back). Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/hook-studio/hooks/generate.)

bodyIds.description: Bodies (from POST /api/v2/hook-studio/bodies/map) the hooks should lead into.

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

formats.description: e.g. question, bold claim, number, POV.

name: hooks_generate
title: Generate hooks (Hook Studio step 2)
